ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can create lesson materials and grade assignments, but understanding why a student cannot engage and helping them believe in learning again remain at the heart of adult education. AI can only assist.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 40,900 adult basic education, adult secondary education, and English as a second language instructors employed in 2024, falling to a projected 35,300 by 2034. That is a net loss of roughly 5,600 jobs, with about 3,900 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $60,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace adult education instructors. Teaching adults combines instruction, support, and rebuilding confidence. Student motivations vary widely, and face-to-face interaction cannot be replaced. AI can help with lesson preparation, differentiated practice, and grading, freeing teachers from repetitive work so they can spend more time with classes and people.
ai_s2_accel: AI conversation practice and pronunciation correction
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of lesson materials and exercises
ai_s3_list: Motivation: help adults believe in learning again.
Differentiated instruction: support multiple levels in one classroom.
Practical explanations: connect knowledge to situations adults recognize.
Empathetic communication: understand students' real-life constraints.
Resource coordination: connect students with examination and employment resources.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places adult education in the low-moderate AI exposure range. AI greatly accelerates lesson preparation, practice, and grading, while face-to-face teaching and motivational support depend on people. AI reduces workload, while people lead the classroom, so near-term replacement risk remains limited.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not make the work effortless. AI lesson-planning and differentiated-practice tools can sharply improve teaching efficiency. Expanding into paid settings such as vocational training and exam preparation can also address the generally low compensation in adult education.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Education students can choose adult education as a specialization. Demand is steady and competition is less intense than in primary and secondary schools. Add a language-teaching credential such as TESOL/TEFL or a vocational training qualification and combine language with occupational skills to broaden employment options.

Use AI teaching tools to reduce lesson-preparation work. Expand into paid settings such as exam preparation, occupational English, and immigrant integration to improve income. Build curriculum-design skills and advance toward instructional supervision or program management.

People with teaching or foreign-language backgrounds can move into adult education quickly. Earn TESOL/TEFL or a teaching credential and begin part-time at a community college or language-training organization. In applications, highlight differentiated teaching and successful adult learner outcomes.

Adult education relies heavily on part-time instructors and experiences high turnover. Stable teaching hours, professional development, and project-based advancement improve retention. Paths into curriculum development and program management protect teaching quality better than continually replacing part-time instructors.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated generation of lesson materials and exercises

ai_s7_trends: Adult education and vocational training converge, increasing demand for instructors with combined expertise.
AI tools reduce lesson-preparation work and improve teaching efficiency.
Demand for language training and immigrant integration services remains steady.

body: Adult basic education, adult secondary education, and English as a second language instructors teach literacy, foundational subjects, secondary-equivalency preparation, and English to adults, helping learners improve educational attainment, language ability, and employment prospects.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can create lesson materials and grade assignments, but understanding why a student cannot engage and helping them believe in learning again remain at the heart of adult education. AI can only assist.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成备课课件、批改作业，但「这位学生为什么学不进去、怎么让他重新相信学习」——成人教育的核心在人，AI 只能打下手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年成人基础教育、成人中等教育、英语作为第二语言在岗约 4.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.53 万人，岗位净减约 0.56 万个，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代成人教育教师：教成人是「教学 + 陪伴 + 重建信心」的复合工作，学生动机千差万别，面对面互动无法替代。AI 能帮的是备课、分层练习、作业批改，把教师从重复劳动里解放出来，把时间还给课堂和人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 口语陪练与发音纠正
多语种翻译与教材辅助
ai_s3_list: 动机激发：让成年人重新相信学习。
分层教学：同一课堂兼顾不同水平。
生活化讲解：把知识装进成人熟悉的情境。
共情沟通：理解学生的现实困境。
资源协调：帮学生对接考试与就业资源。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明成人教育是「低中度 AI 曝光」的教学岗位：备课、练习、批改等环节被 AI 大幅加速，但面对面教学和动机陪伴依赖人，属于「AI 减负、人守课堂」的典型，短期替代风险不高。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于能省心：把 AI 备课和分层练习工具用起来，教学效率翻倍；同时往职业培训、考试辅导等付费场景延伸，可以改善成人教育待遇普遍不高的问题。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 教育专业的孩子可以把成人教育作为细分方向：需求稳定、竞争不如中小学激烈；建议同时考语言教学认证（TESOL/TEFL）或职业培训资质，往「语言 + 职业技能」复合方向走，就业面更宽。
把 AI 教学工具用起来，减轻备课负担；往考试辅导、职业英语、移民融入等付费场景延伸，收入结构更健康；同时积累课程设计能力，往教学主管或项目管理者转型。
有教学或外语背景的人转成人教育上手快：考一个 TESOL/TEFL 或教师资格证，从社区学院、语言培训机构兼职做起；求职时突出分层教学和成人学员成功案例。
成人教育师资兼职化、流动大，留人靠「课时稳定 + 专业发展 + 项目化成长」：给教师设计课程研发和项目管理通道，比不断换兼职教师更能保证教学质量。

ai_s7_trends: 成人教育与职业培训融合，复合型教师吃香。
AI 工具减轻备课负担，教学效率提升。
语言培训与移民融入服务需求稳定。

body: 成人基础教育、成人中等教育与英语第二语言教师面向成年人开展识字与基础学科教学、高中同等学力辅导和英语语言教学，帮助学习者提升学历、语言能力与就业竞争力。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring and alerts can be automated, but technicians remain responsible for on-site response and operating-condition judgments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 31,600 biomass plant technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 28,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 3,600 jobs, with approximately 2,500 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $99,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Biomass Plant Technicians, but it will automate monitoring and alerts. Systems adjust operating conditions and issue alarms automatically, shifting technicians from watching screens to handling anomalies and working on site. Pure monitoring roles face displacement, while people who can respond and make adjustments become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Operating-condition judgment: depends on people.
Material-blockage response: depends on human feel.
On-site adjustment: depends on experience.
Emergency shutdown and startup: depends on human responsiveness.
Safety oversight: people accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means this occupation operates in an area of meaningful AI exposure. Monitoring is increasingly automated, while response and judgment still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Substantial exposure does not mean universal risk. Pure monitoring is being replaced, not on-site response. People who can adjust equipment and work in the plant become scarcer and more valuable as technology advances. Those limited to watching screens face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study mechanical and electrical engineering or energy technology, and obtain required special-operations certifications.
Advance from inspection rounds to control-room operation while building experience across operating conditions.
Emphasize monitoring and incident response, and clearly identify the generating units you have supported.
Assess candidates for steady execution and discipline. People willing and able to work on site are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent monitoring becomes widespread.
Systems diagnose faults automatically.
On-site response skills become scarcer.

body: Biomass Plant Technicians work with boilers and fuel-feed systems to monitor combustion conditions, adjust operating parameters, handle material blockages and slagging, convert crop residues into electricity, and maintain safe and stable generation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Monitoring and alerts can be automated, but technicians remain responsible for on-site response and operating-condition judgments.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监控与预警能被自动化，但现场处置与工况判断，还是技术员扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物质电厂技术员在岗约 3.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.80 万人，岗位净减约 0.36 万个，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物质技术员，但会自动化监控与预警。系统自调工况、自报警，技术员从「盯屏」转向「处异常、下现场」。真正被挤掉的是纯监控，会处置会调节的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 工况判断：脑子靠人。
堵料处置：手感靠人。
现场调节：经验靠人。
应急停启：反应靠人。
安全把关：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的运行区——监控被吃，但处置与判断仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「纯监控」，不是「现场处置」的岗位。会调节、能下现场的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会盯屏的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读机电/能源，考特种作业证。
从巡检升级成主控，攒工况经验。
突出监控与处置，写清跟过哪些机组。
选人看稳手与纪律，能下现场的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 智能监控普及。
故障自诊断。
现场处置更缺。

body: 生物质电厂技术员是围绕锅炉与给料，监控燃烧工况、调节运行参数、处理堵料结焦，把秸秆变成电能、保障安全稳定发电的职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监控与预警能被自动化，但现场处置与工况判断，还是技术员扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can review literature, clean data, and draft reports, but analysts still judge whether an emissions target should be 30% or 35%, who bears the cost, and how to gain agreement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 90,300 Climate Change Policy Analysts were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 94,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,000 jobs, with about 8,500 annual job openings. The median annual salary is about $80,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will deeply change policy analysis without replacing the analyst. It accelerates literature reviews, data cleaning, first drafts, and charts. Analysts shift their attention toward testing model assumptions, explaining policy implications, and coordinating stakeholder interests. Those responsibilities still require human judgment.
ai_s2_accel: Climate models and AI forecasts assist pathway analysis
Intelligent comparison of policy text and compliance clauses
Intelligent ESG and carbon-market data platforms
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted literature reviews and source discovery
Automated data cleaning and preliminary statistics
ai_s3_list: Policy judgment: weigh interests and tradeoffs behind the data.
Model scrutiny: determine whether assumptions hold and results are credible.
Cross-agency coordination: align parties around one approach.
Communication: explain complex models to decision-makers.
Value choices: balance efficiency, fairness, and feasibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high exposure range. AI generates literature reviews, data work, first drafts, and charts. Policy analysis still depends on value judgments grounded in evidence, so analysts remain responsible for recommendations and tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not remove the career path. Junior analysts limited to repetitive work face the greatest risk because AI works faster. Senior analysts who manage models, understand policy, and coordinate interests become more valuable when AI frees their time.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This occupation values advanced education and research ability. Start with a master's degree in environmental policy, public policy, or energy economics. Practice data analysis in Python/R and develop strong writing. Internships at think tanks or government research bodies provide practical value.

Use AI tools to save time for judgment and coordination. Expand into commercially active fields such as carbon markets, ESG, and green finance instead of relying only on government projects. Research ability and policy awareness protect your value.

Economics, statistics, and environmental-engineering backgrounds transfer well. Build credibility with a carbon-management or ESG credential, and bring completed analysis projects to interviews instead of discussing ideals alone.

Assign repetitive junior work to AI and recruit people who combine modeling, policy knowledge, and coordination. Strong data tools and real project experience produce more value than simply adding staff.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Clean data, run statistics, and build models
Search literature and extract review findings
Provide corporate disclosure and rating data

ai_s7_trends: Carbon-neutrality policy and expanding carbon markets increase demand for policy analysts.
AI takes over data organization and first drafts, shifting analysts toward judgment and coordination.
ESG and green finance create new commercial destinations for analysts.

body: Climate Change Policy Analysts specialize in climate-related data and policy. They collect and analyze climate, energy, and emissions data, build evaluation models, assess policy effects, and provide findings to government.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can review literature, clean data, and draft reports, but analysts still judge whether an emissions target should be 30% or 35%, who bears the cost, and how to gain agreement.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能替你整理文献、清洗数据、写报告初稿，但「这个减排目标定 30% 还是 35%、谁承担成本、怎么说服各方」，还得分析师自己做判断、去协调。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年气候变化政策分析师在岗约 9.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.43 万人，净增约 0.40 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会深度改变政策分析的工作方式，但不会取代分析师这个角色：文献综述、数据清洗、初稿写作、图表生成都会被 AI 加速，分析师的精力转向「判断模型假设、解释政策含义、协调各方利益」——这正是 AI 最给不了的部分。
ai_s2_accel: 气候模型与 AI 预测辅助路径推演
碳排放核算工具的自动化
政策文本与合规条款的智能比对
ESG 与碳市场数据的智能分析平台
ai_s2_auto: 文献综述与资料检索 AI 化
数据清洗与初步统计自动化
报告初稿与摘要的 AI 生成
图表与汇报材料自动制作
ai_s3_list: 政策判断：数据背后的利益与取舍。
模型审慎：假设是否成立、结果是否可信。
跨部门协调：把各方拉到一个方案上。
沟通表达：把复杂模型讲给决策者听。
价值取舍：效率、公平、可行性的权衡。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的「研究动作」正被 AI 大幅替代：文献、数据、初稿、图表都能自动生成，但政策分析的本质是「基于事实做价值判断」，模型和 AI 提供素材，最终的建议和取舍还是分析师来拍。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没前途：会重复劳动的初级分析师风险最大，因为 AI 干得更快；但能驾驭模型、理解政策、协调利益的高级分析师，反而因为 AI 释放了时间而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这个岗位看重学历和研究能力，建议硕士起步，选环境政策、公共政策、能源经济方向。多练数据分析（Python/R）和写作，实习去智库或政府研究机构比刷简历有用。
把 AI 工具用起来，省下时间做判断和协调。往碳市场、ESG、绿色金融这些商业需求旺盛的方向拓展，别只守着政府项目；研究能力和政策敏感度是你不会被替代的本钱。
有经济、统计、环境工程背景的人转行最顺。先考个碳管理、ESG 相关证书建立可信度，求职时带上你做过的分析项目，别只谈理想。
初级岗位的重复劳动交给 AI，招聘重点放在「会建模 + 懂政策 + 能协调」的复合人才；给分析师配好数据工具和项目历练，比堆人头有效率。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 排放因子与核算自动化
气候影响的空间可视化

ai_s7_trends: 双碳政策与碳市场扩容带动政策分析人才需求增长。
AI 接管数据整理与初稿写作，分析师转向判断与协调。
ESG、绿色金融等商业场景成为分析师的新去处。

body: 气候变化政策分析师指专门研究气候变化相关数据与政策的人员，负责收集分析气候、能源、排放数据，构建评估模型，分析政策影响，并向政府。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能替你整理文献、清洗数据、写报告初稿，但「这个减排目标定 30% 还是 35%、谁承担成本、怎么说服各方」，还得分析师自己做判断、去协调。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Motion capture can assist rehearsals, but Dancers still control physical execution and emotional expression in live performance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,300 Dancers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 12,900 by 2034. That represents about 600 net new jobs and roughly 1,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $51,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dancers, but it will reduce repetitive ensemble work. Motion capture and virtual doubles accelerate repeated group sequences, shifting Dancers toward solo expression, choreography, and teaching. Performers limited to repetitive movement face pressure, while those with expressive and creative ability become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Physical expression: the body conveys emotion.
Live control: people manage timing.
Choreographic ability: people create the work.
Injury prevention and conditioning: people protect their bodies.
Stage presence: people create the audience impact.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this performing-arts career in the moderate AI exposure range. Technology accelerates ensemble work, while live expression remains human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Repetitive ensemble movement is replaceable, but solo expression is not. Dancers who communicate emotion and create choreography become more scarce as production grows more efficient. Those limited to repeated movement face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong technique and choreography skills through professional dance training. Pure ensemble work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop expressive ability early.
Move from ensemble performance toward solo work + choreography, and learn to use movement-analysis tools.
Emphasize completed works and commercial performances, and state which companies you have worked with. Companies value consistency and commitment.
Do not cast on appearance alone. Assess expressive intelligence. A core performer who can choreograph deserves stronger roles.

ai_s7_trends: Virtual doubles reduce ensemble work
Cultural-tourism productions and short videos retain demand
Creative ability becomes more valuable

body: Dancers perform and arrange movement. They coordinate rehearsals, technical integration, and shows, using physical language and technique to create stage expression and original work.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Motion capture can assist rehearsals, but Dancers still control physical execution and emotional expression in live performance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 动作捕捉能辅助排练，但现场表演的肢体控制和情绪表达，还是舞者定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年舞者在岗约 1.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.29 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代舞者，但会压缩群演。动作捕捉与虚拟替身把重复群舞提速，舞者从「跳群演」挪向「独舞表达、编创、教学」。真正被挤掉的是只跳重复动作的，有表达力能编创的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 肢体表达：情绪靠身传。
现场控制：节奏靠人控。
编创能力：作品靠人创。
伤防保养：身体靠人护。
舞台气场：感染靠人给。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的演艺区——群演被加速，但现场表达还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「重复群舞」动作，不是「独舞表达」的岗位。有表达力、能编创的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跳重复动作的舞者。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 舞专起步多练功底和编创，AI 时代纯群演在缩，早点练表达。
从「跳群演」升级成「做独舞 + 编创」，学动作分析。
突出作品和商演，写清跟过哪些团。剧团看重稳和拼。
选人别只看外形，要看有没有表达脑子。能编创的骨干值得给好角色。

ai_s7_trends: 群演被虚拟替

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can diagnose faults remotely and predict component aging, but technicians still handle rail alignment in the shaft, judge wire-rope condition by touch, and manage the critical minutes of a passenger entrapment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 24,200 Elevator And Escalator Installers And Repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 25,400 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,200 jobs, with about 2,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $106,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Elevator And Escalator Installers And Repairers, but it will change maintenance practices. Remote monitoring, AI fault diagnosis, and predictive maintenance are spreading. Technicians increasingly arrive with diagnostic findings instead of responding without context. Machines cannot replace installation craft, mechanical adjustment, electrical troubleshooting, or emergency rescue. Technicians who use these systems well work faster and remain in high demand.
ai_s2_accel: Wider use of AI predictive maintenance
ai_s3_list: Shaft installation craft: a one-millimeter error in rail or door-operator alignment can cause vibration.
Complex fault diagnosis: experience helps locate unusual noise, vibration, and abnormal door operation.
Mechanical and electrical commissioning: strong mechanical repair must be paired with knowledge of control logic.
Emergency response: during passenger entrapment, safe rescue comes first.
Safety responsibility and compliance: elevators are regulated equipment, so no step can be skipped.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate exposure. AI increasingly supports diagnosis and scheduling through remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance, but hands-on craft and on-site judgment remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI shifts maintenance from reactive repairs to predictive servicing. Technicians spend less time on routine travel and more on complex faults and modernization. Pure inspection roles will shrink, while installers and repairers who understand systems and troubleshoot effectively become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study electromechanics or elevator installation and repair at a technical school, then earn the required regulated-equipment credential. The occupation has steady demand and income, but entrants must tolerate heights, shafts, and physically difficult conditions.

Learn remote monitoring and AI diagnostic tools, and pursue advanced elevator installation and repair qualifications. Build expertise in escalators, high-speed elevators, and modernization projects instead of remaining in pure inspection work.

An electrical or mechanical foundation is helpful, but beginners can start as maintenance apprentices. State clearly which control systems you understand, which faults you have resolved, and which credentials you hold.

Prioritize credentials and personal responsibility when hiring because maintenance quality depends on careful technicians. Equip teams with remote diagnostic systems to increase the number of units each technician can maintain safely.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Monitoring of vibration, temperature, and door systems

ai_s7_trends: Maintenance shifts from reactive repairs to predictive servicing. AI diagnosis becomes standard, while technicians focus on complex faults and modernization.
The installed base of elevators and demand for aging-system modernization continue to grow, sustaining a long-term shortage of installation and maintenance talent.
Smart elevators and digital control systems increase demand for technicians with integrated mechanical and electrical skills.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电梯与自动扶梯安装维修人员在岗约 2.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.54 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.66 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电梯安装维修人员，但会改变维保方式。远程监控、AI 故障诊断、预测性维保正普及，师傅从「被动跑现场」转向「带着诊断结论上井道」；但安装手艺、机械调整、电气排障和应急救援，机器替代不了。会用系统的师傅效率更高，也更抢手。
ai_s2_accel: 改造方案 AI 辅助设计
ai_s3_list: 井道安装手艺：导轨、门机的精度，差一毫米都抖。
疑难故障排查：异响、抖动、开关门异常，靠经验定位。
机械电气联调：机械修得好还要懂控制逻辑。
应急救援的临场：困人处置，安全救人是第一位。
安全责任与规范：特种设备，一步不能省。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半「诊断与排程」环节正被 AI 介入——远程诊断、预测维保都成熟了，但现场的手艺和判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让维保从「坏了才修」变成「预测保养」，师傅从跑腿中解放出来，专注疑难故障和改造升级。纯巡检岗被压缩，会排障、懂系统的安装维修师傅更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读技校机电、电梯安装与维修专业，考特种设备作业证。这行缺人、收入稳，重点是能吃得了高处和井道的苦。
把远程监控、AI 诊断工具用熟，考更高级别的电梯安装维修资质。往扶梯、高速梯、改造项目等方向走，避开纯巡检。
有电气、机械基础最好，无经验可从维保学徒做起。简历上多写「懂什么控制系统、处理过哪些故障、持什么证」。
招人重点看持证情况和责任心，维保质量靠师傅的较真。给团队配好远程诊断系统，能提升人均维保台量。

ai_s7_trends: 维保从「坏了才修」转向「预测性保养」，AI 诊断成为标配，师傅聚焦疑难故障与改造。
电梯保有量与老旧电梯改造需求持续增长，安装维保人才缺口长期存在。
智能电梯普及，控制系统数字化，机电一体化复合师傅更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Process controls can stabilize parameters automatically, but operators still align centers and adjust clearances during product changeovers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 57,300 machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 58,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,100 jobs, with about 5,200 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $45,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Extruding, Forming, Pressing, And Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders as a whole, but it will handle standard feeding and monitoring tasks. Automated feeding and process controls reduce machine watching, shifting people toward setup, die changes, and troubleshooting. Operators who only watch screens face pressure, while those who install equipment, set dies, and understand processes become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Die-change guidance and digital work instructions
ai_s2_auto: Automated feeding and continuous material supply
ai_s3_list: Machine setup and die changes: people align centers.
Troubleshooting: people clear material blockages.
Process judgment: experience defines the operating window.
Equipment maintenance: people respond to unexpected failures.
Coordination: connect setup, operation, and inspection.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Systems take over feeding and monitoring, while people still handle machine setup, die changes, and faults.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure can support stable work. Automation replaces screen watching, not the entire role. Workers who set machines, change dies, and understand processes become more efficient. Those who only monitor screens and avoid setup skills face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in electromechanical or die technology and spend time on machines while in school. Screen monitoring is shrinking in the AI era, so develop setup and die-change skills early.
Move from machine watching into setup and die changes. Learn multiple machine types and pursue lead-operator or process-technician roles.
Highlight machine-setup experience and yield results, and list the material types you have processed. Die experience is an advantage.
Do not hire based only on endurance. Evaluate how candidates think about machine setup. Operators who change dies and protect yield merit higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated feeding and process controls continue to reduce machine-watching jobs.
Machine-setup and die-change skills gain importance.
Operators who understand multiple machines and materials are in greater demand.

body: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, And Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders run equipment that turns plastic, rubber, ceramic, and powder feedstock into pipes, profiles, and blanks. They monitor temperature and pressure, set machines, change dies, and protect dimensions and yield.

综合协调：把设操检串起来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can run tests, but technicians still decide what to test and how to interpret exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 20,400 Food Science Technicians employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 21,300 by 2034, a net gain of about 900 jobs, with roughly 3,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Food Science Technicians, but it will reduce routine laboratory work. Automated testing and data systems speed up standard analyses. Work is shifting from running samples toward method design, exception assessment, and compliance support. People limited to standard samples face displacement, while technicians who design methods and interpret results gain value.
ai_s3_list: Method design: people decide which questions to ask.
Exception assessment: people interpret what results mean.
Compliance support: people exercise judgment.
Pilot validation: people contribute practical judgment.
Sensory quality checks: people contribute experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Systems speed up testing and data work, while people retain method design and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces the act of running standard samples, not roles centered on method design and judgment. As food-safety demands rise, technicians who design methods and interpret results become scarcer. The main risk is remaining limited to sample processing.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with food science or chemistry and practice method development and technical writing. Routine analysis is shrinking in the AI era, so build design skills early.
Move from running samples toward combined method and compliance work, and learn laboratory information systems.
Highlight credentials and production lines, and specify the product categories you have handled.
Do not select candidates only for speed. Assess whether they can interpret abnormal results. Strong performers deserve a path into quality control.

ai_s7_trends: Automated testing continues to spread.
Food-safety demand is increasing.
People with sound judgment are in greater demand.

body: Food Science Technicians perform physical, chemical, and microbiological tests on food. They support pilot production and recipe validation, monitor safety and quality parameters, and help keep products compliant and production stable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 43,900 medical transcriptionists were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 41,800 by 2034. That represents roughly 2,100 fewer jobs, with about 7,400 openings per year and median annual pay of approximately $37,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is replacing medical transcriptionists more thoroughly than it replaces most occupations. Speech recognition and medical large language models turn dictation directly into drafts, sharply reducing demand for manual transcription. People are still needed for quality control, terminology verification, and privacy safeguards. The path forward is not continued dictation work, but movement into health-record quality control, coding, and data governance.
ai_s2_accel: Medical large language models assisting with draft medical records
Intelligent correction of terms and drug names
ai_s2_auto: Automated speech transcription of dictated recordings
Automated completion of medical terminology and templates
Automated extraction and alignment of prior medical records
ai_s3_list: Terminology safeguards: final verification of uncommon drug names and anatomical terms.
Contextual judgment: distinguishing slips of the tongue and homophones.
Quality-control accountability: a signature carries responsibility.
Privacy compliance: medical-record security and de-identification.
Professional transition: movement into coding and data governance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderately high-exposure transcription area. Models can directly perform speech transcription, rapidly concentrating human value in quality control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means high risk in this occupation because transcription itself is being replaced. The true moat is medical expertise, quality-control responsibility, and the ability to move into medical-record coding and data governance. Pure transcriptionists face the highest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat transcription as the destination. Study medical fundamentals and coding, then move toward health information roles. Pure dictation work has no future in the AI era.
Immediately build medical-record coding and quality-control skills and earn a coding credential. Advance from transcription toward quality control and coding to preserve your role.
Do not apply for pure transcription roles. Highlight medical-terminology and quality-control experience and move toward health records, coding, or healthcare data positions.
Assess medical expertise and quality-control ability, not only typing speed. Combined roles that cover coding and quality control offer greater value.

ai_s7_trends: Speech recognition and medical large language models absorb most manual transcription.
Roles migrate toward medical-record quality control and coding.
Healthcare data governance creates a new pathway.

body: Medical transcriptionists convert clinicians' dictated medical histories, diagnoses, procedures, and operative reports into standardized written medical documents. They verify medical terminology and formatting and ensure records are accurate, searchable, and compliant with privacy requirements.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn dictated speech directly into a draft, but a person still performs the final check that a drug name is spelled correctly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把一段口述直接变成草稿，但「这个药名拼对没有」，还得人最后核一眼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医疗文书转录员在岗约 4.39 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.18 万人，岗位净减约 0.21 万个，年均产生约 0.74 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在取代医疗文书转录员，且比多数职业更彻底。语音识别和医疗大模型把口述直接转成草稿，人工听写需求骤降。但质控、术语核对和隐私把关仍要人。这行的出路不是「继续听写」，而是转向病案质控、编码与数据治理。
ai_s2_accel: 医疗大模型辅助生成病历草稿
术语与药名的智能纠错
ai_s2_auto: 口述录音的自动语音转写
医学术语与模板的自动填充
既往病历的自动抽取与对齐
格式化与基础排版自动化
ai_s3_list: 术语把关：生僻药名和解剖术语的终核。
语境判断：口误和同音词的辨别。
质控责任：签字即担责。
隐私合规：病历安全与脱敏。
专业迁移：转编码与数据治理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的转录区——语音转写能被模型直接完成，人工价值快速收缩到质控。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光在这里就是高风险：被替代的是「听写」本身。真正的护城河是医学专业度和质控责任，以及往病案编码、数据治理的迁移能力。纯听写员风险最高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别把转录当终点。学医学基础 + 编码，往病案信息师走。AI 时代纯听写没前途。
立刻补病案编码和质控技能，考编码证。从「听写」升级成「质控 + 编码」，保住岗位。
别投纯转录岗。突出你的医学术语和质控经验，往病案、编码、医疗数据岗转。
招人看医学专业度和质控力，不止看打字速度。能兼编码与质控的复合岗更值。

ai_s7_trends: 语音识别与医疗大模型基本吞掉人工听写。
岗位向病案质控与编码迁移。
医疗数据治理成新出口。

body: 医疗文书转录员将医师口述的病历、诊断、处置与手术记录转写为规范的书面医疗文书，核对医学术语与格式，确保病历准确可查并符合隐私规范。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把一段口述直接变成草稿，但「这个药名拼对没有」，还得人最后核一眼。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Imaging and alerts can help physicians detect problems earlier, but physicians' hands and judgment still deliver babies and make surgical incisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 21,500 obstetricians and gynecologists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 21,700 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 200 jobs, with roughly 600 annual openings. Median annual pay in 2024 was ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace obstetricians and gynecologists, but it will reduce image-reading and documentation roles. Image recognition and complication alerts accelerate diagnosis, shifting people from reviewing images and writing records toward decisions, surgery, communication, and follow-up. Routine image interpretation faces replacement, while physicians who operate and handle emergencies remain more secure.
ai_s3_list: Surgical decisions: people make the incision.
Emergency response: people decide during crises.
Patient communication: people build trust.
Treatment tradeoffs: people weigh benefits and risks.
Complex pregnancy: people build experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a medium-AI-exposure diagnostic-support category. Systems accelerate image interpretation and alerts, but people retain responsibility for decisions and surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces routine image interpretation, not clinical decision-making roles. Physicians who operate and handle emergencies become scarcer as efficiency rises, while those limited to reading images face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in clinical medicine and rotate through obstetrics and gynecology early. Pure image interpretation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop surgical and communication skills.
Advance from reviewing images and writing records to decisions + surgery + follow-up, and learn imaging-assistance tools.
Highlight residency training and surgical volume. Hospitals value steadiness and stress tolerance.
Do not assess candidates solely by education; evaluate surgical foundations and composure in emergencies.

ai_s7_trends: Imaging assistance spreads.
Assisted reproduction drives demand.
People who operate and handle emergencies are more sought after.

body: Obstetricians and gynecologists diagnose and treat female reproductive health and pregnancy and childbirth, coordinating prenatal examinations, delivery, gynecologic surgery, medication plans, and postpartum follow-up to protect maternal and infant safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Imaging and alerts can help physicians detect problems earlier, but physicians' hands and judgment still deliver babies and make surgical incisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 影像和预警能帮医生看更早，但接生和手术的那一刀，还是医生的手和判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年妇产科医师在岗约 2.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.17 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代妇产科医师，但会压缩读片与记录岗。影像识别和并发症预警把诊断提速，人从「看片写病历」挪向「决策、手术、沟通和随访」。真正被替的是常规读片，会手术能应急的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 手术决策：刀靠人开。
急诊应变：突发靠人断。
医患沟通：信任靠人建。
方案取舍：利弊靠人衡。
复杂妊娠：经验靠人攒。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的诊断辅助区——读片和预警被系统加速，但决策和手术还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规读片」动作，不是「临床决策」的岗位。有手术能力、能应急的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看片、不动手的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 临床医学打底，早进妇产科轮转，AI 时代纯读片在缩，多练手术和沟通。
从「看片写病历」升级成「决策 + 手术 + 随访」，学影像辅助。
突出规培和手术量，医院看稳和抗压。
选人别只看学历，看有没有手术底子和应急定力。

ai_s7_trends: 影像辅助普及。
辅助生殖带需求。
会手术能应急更抢手。

body: 妇产科医师负责女性生殖健康与妊娠分娩的诊疗，统筹产前检查、接生助产、妇科手术、用药方案与产后随访，保障母婴安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 影像和预警能帮医生看更早，但接生和手术的那一刀，还是医生的手和判断。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI moves files through the cloud, and printers are used less and less. The occupation's true competitor is not AI replacement, but paperless workflows making the act of pressing buttons disappear.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 25,500 computer operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 21,600 by 2034, a net loss of about 3,900 jobs, with approximately 2,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $39,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and paperless workflows are ending pure operating roles. Electronic signatures, cloud documents, and print-on-demand eliminate much printing and copying demand, completely replacing operators who only press buttons. Equipment will not disappear entirely, and demand remains for digital printing, equipment maintenance, supplies, and asset management. Operators must change from people who run machines into people who repair and manage them.
ai_s2_auto: Digital files replacing printing and copying
Widespread cloud documents and electronic signatures
ai_s3_list: Equipment repair: on-site handling of paper jams and image smearing.
Finishing processes: binding and lamination skills.
Supply management: inventory and cost control.
Customer service: remain dependable during rush jobs.
Learning agility: master new equipment quickly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 makes office machine operation a moderate-high exposure support occupation. Paperless workflows continue to replace printing and copying demand, creating high risk for pure operating roles, but demand remains for equipment repair, digital printing, and asset management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure makes transformation essential. Move toward equipment repair, digital printing technology, and office asset management, making machine repair your core skill. The more complete the paperless transition, the more essential repair and asset management become.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people should not treat pure operation as a career direction. Study office equipment repair or digital printing technology, or move into administration and asset management, applying hands-on ability to advanced equipment.

Proactively learn digital printing, large-format output, and equipment repair and earn relevant skill certificates. Upgrade document services from printing to document solutions that save employers money and protect your role.

People with equipment repair or printing backgrounds can transition into office equipment maintenance or digital printing operations. In interviews, emphasize hands-on ability; a case where you repaired a jammed machine is especially persuasive.

The path forward for document-production roles is equipment management. Develop pure operators into asset administrators who can repair equipment and manage supplies, using digital printing and self-service terminals to divert simple demand and raise team value.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Perfect binding, saddle stitching, and wire binding

ai_s7_trends: Paperless offices continue to expand, reducing traditional printing and copying demand.
Digital printing and large-format output are shifting toward on-demand production.
Operating roles are shifting toward equipment maintenance and office asset management.

body: Office Machine Operators, Except Computer, operate copiers, printing presses, binding machines, laminators, and other office equipment to print, copy, bind, and finish documents. They also maintain equipment, manage supplies, and troubleshoot faults.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI moves files through the cloud, and printers are used less and less. The occupation's true competitor is not AI replacement, but paperless workflows making the act of pressing buttons disappear.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 让文件在云端流转，打印机越来越少被用到——这个岗位真正的对手不是 AI 取代，而是无纸化让「按键」本身消失。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员计算机在岗约 2.55 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.16 万人，岗位净减约 0.39 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和无纸化正在终结纯操作岗：电子签名、云端文档、按需印刷让大量打印复印需求消失，只负责按键的操作员会被彻底替代。但设备不会全部消失，数字印刷、设备维护、耗材和资产管理仍有需求——操作员必须从「按机器的人」变成「修机器、管设备的人」。
ai_s2_accel: 大幅面与特种打印设备
ai_s2_auto: 文件电子化替代打印复印
云端文档与电子签名普及
订单与计费系统自动化
ai_s3_list: 设备维修：卡纸、糊版的现场处理。
后道工艺：装订、塑封的手艺。
耗材管理：库存与成本控制。
客户服务：赶工时不掉链子。
学习能力：新设备上手快。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明办公机器操作是「中高曝光」的后勤岗位：打印复印需求被无纸化持续替代，纯操作岗风险大，但设备维修、数字印刷和资产管理仍有需求。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着必须转型：往设备维修、数字印刷技术、办公资产管理走，把「会修机器」变成你的核心技能，无纸化越彻底，维修和资产管理越刚需。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议年轻人把纯操作当职业方向：学办公设备维修、数字印刷技术，或者转行政与资产管理，把动手能力往高端设备上靠。
主动学数字印刷、大幅面输出和设备维修，考相关技能证书；把文印服务从「打印」升级到「文件解决方案」，给单位省成本，你就不会被裁。
有设备维修、印刷背景的可以转型做办公设备维护或数字印刷操作；面试时强调动手能力，讲一个你修好卡纸设备的案例最加分。
文印岗的出路是「设备管理」：把纯操作员培养成能维修、会管耗材的资产管理员，用数字印刷和自助终端分流简单需求，团队价值会提升。

ai_s7_trends: 无纸化办公持续推进，传统打印复印需求萎缩。
数字印刷与大幅面输出转向按需生产。
操作岗向设备维护与办公资产管理转型。

body: 办公机器操作员（不含计算机）操作复印机、印刷机、装订机、塑封机等办公设备，完成文件打印、复印、装订与后道加工，并负责设备维护、耗材管理与故障处理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 让文件在云端流转，打印机越来越少被用到——这个岗位真正的对手不是 AI 取代，而是无纸化让「按键」本身消失。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Generative imaging can produce ten images instantly, but photographers still decide which one has soul and whether it captures the feeling the client wants.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 151,200 photographers were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 154,000, a net increase of about 2,800 jobs, with about 12,700 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $42,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace photographers with aesthetic judgment, but it will accelerate editing and asset creation. Automated color grading, generative backgrounds, and intelligent facial retouching speed repetitive work, shifting photographers from shooting and editing toward creative concepts, on-site execution, client communication, and style control. Routine ID-photo and stock-image work faces displacement, while photographers with distinctive styles and execution skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated color grading and batch processing
Intelligent facial retouching and skin smoothing
ai_s3_list: Creative concepts: people define the character.
Candid moments: people wait for the instant.
Client communication: people discuss the desired feeling.
Style control: people set the tone.
Directing emotion: people lead subjects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates moderately high exposure in image production. Systems greatly accelerate editing and assets, while people retain aesthetic judgment and on-site execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean complete replacement. Routine ID photos and stock assets face substitution, not creative execution. Photographers with distinctive styles who direct subjects and control a set become scarcer as productivity rises. People who only press the shutter face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through art or media study and shoot and edit extensively while in school. Pure stock-image work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop style and communication early.
Advance from taking photos to developing concepts + controlling the set. Learn generative tools and pursue lead-photographer or studio-owner roles.
Highlight your portfolio and client experience, clearly stating the types of projects you have followed. Clients value aesthetic judgment and reliability.
When hiring, assess style, not equipment alone. Lead photographers who control the set and consistently deliver strong images deserve premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Generative imaging reduces routine demand.
High-end commercial photography and content still need people.
Photographers with distinctive styles and set-control skills are in greater demand.

body: Photographers use cameras, lighting, and post-production software to shoot and refine images in commercial, portrait, news, and artistic fields. They control composition, light, and emotion, translate client needs, and deliver finished images.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Generative imaging can produce ten images instantly, but photographers still decide which one has soul and whether it captures the feeling the client wants.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 生成式影像能瞬间甩出十张图，但哪张有灵魂、客户要的那种感觉对不对，还是摄影师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年摄影师在岗约 15.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.40 万人，净增约 0.28 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代有审美的摄影师，但会加速修图与素材。自动调色、生成式背景和智能修脸把重复工作提速，摄影师从「拍和修」挪向「创意方案、现场执行、客户沟通、风格把控」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规证件照和素材的人，有风格能执行的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 创意方案：气质靠人定。
现场抓拍：瞬间靠人等。
客户沟通：感觉靠人聊。
风格把控：调性靠人定。
导拍情绪：人来带。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的影像区——修图素材被系统大幅加速，但审美与现场执行还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全替代：被替代的是「常规证件照与素材」动作，不是「创意执行」的岗位。有风格、能导拍控场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会按快门的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 艺术或传媒本科打底，在校多拍多修。AI 时代纯素材在缩，早点练风格和沟通。
从「拍照」升级成「做方案 + 控场」，学生成式工具，争取做主摄或开工作室。
突出作品与客户经验，写清跟过哪些类型。甲方看重审美和稳。
选人别只看器材，要看有没有风格。能控场出片的主摄，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式影像压常规需求。
高端商拍与内容仍缺人。
有风格能控场的人更抢手。

body: 摄影师（Photographers）运用相机、灯光与后期软件，在商业、人像、新闻或艺术等方向拍摄并修整影像，把控构图光线与情绪，对接客户需求交付成片。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 生成式影像能瞬间甩出十张图，但哪张有灵魂、客户要的那种感觉对不对，还是摄影师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate drawings automatically, but engineers still determine the design, protect safety, and coordinate stakeholders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 368,900 transportation engineers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 387,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 18,600 jobs, with about 23,600 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $99,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace transportation engineers, but it will take over standard design. Simulation optimization and generative drafting accelerate routine plans, shifting engineers from drawing toward complex decisions, safety assessment, and multi-party coordination. Pure drafting will face pressure, while people who understand systems and make decisions will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Complex decisions: People make tradeoffs.
Safety assessment: People protect the baseline.
Multi-party coordination: people balance interests.
Field assessment: People interpret terrain.
Value judgment: People make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range. Systems accelerate parts of the work, but people remain essential where judgment and accountability are required.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces standard drawing tasks, not complex decisions and safety assessment. People with systems thinking and decision-making ability will become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only create drawings are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in civil or transportation engineering and practice modeling and systems thinking. Pure drafting is shrinking in the AI era, so develop decision-making skills early.
Advance from drawing to decision-making and coordination. Learn codes and safety requirements.
Highlight projects and plans. Design institutes value reliability and precision.
Do not hire based only on drawings. Assess systems thinking and decision-making. Key engineers deserve project responsibility.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation is spreading, reducing drafting work.
Complex decisions create opportunities.
Engineers who make decisions are more secure.

body: Transportation engineers lead the planning and design of roads and transportation systems, coordinating traffic flow, alignment, and safety and using modeling and standards to produce buildable plans.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate drawings automatically, but engineers still determine the design, protect safety, and coordinate stakeholders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动成图，但怎么定、安全怎么守、各方怎么协调，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运输工程师在岗约 36.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.75 万人，净增约 1.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.96 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运输工程师，但会接管标准设计。仿真优化与生成式成图把常规方案提速，工程师从「画图」挪向「复杂决策、安全研判、多方协调」。真正被挤掉的是纯成图，懂系统、能决策的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 复杂决策：取舍靠人。
安全研判：底线靠人。
多方协调：利益靠人。
现场研判：地形靠人。
价值判断：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「画标准图」动作，不是「复杂决策与安全研判」的岗位。有系统力、能决策的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会成图。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 土木/交通起步多练建模和系统，AI 时代纯成图在缩，早点练决策。
从「画图」升级成「决策 + 协调」，学规范与安全。
突出项目与方案，院里看重稳和准。
选人别只看图，看系统和决策，骨干值得给项目。

ai_s7_trends: 仿真普及，成图缩。
复杂决策带来机会。
能决策的工程师更稳。
